## Accent, layout and quality-of-life update

PriceRadar 1.5.6 improves the permanent One UI interface and makes everyday watchlist management faster.

### What changed

- Accent colours now consistently cover dashboard gradients, icons, navigation, switches and selected controls.
- Invalid saved palette values are repaired automatically, preventing missing radar icons and invisible accent controls.
- The phone-sized empty watchlist card no longer sits underneath the bottom navigation bar.
- Product cards gain quick refresh and pause/resume actions, relative check times and stale-price warnings.
- Removed products can be restored with Undo.
- Settings gains bulk pause, bulk resume and failed-check retry actions.
- Watchlist status shortcuts jump to active, target-reached and failed products.
- Product details add target presets, a target-progress bar and copy-link feedback.
- URL entry gains one-tap clipboard paste, while the coupon screen gets a polished empty state.

Download **PriceRadar-1.5.6.apk** below. The signing key is unchanged, so it can be installed over the previous build. Android version code: 14. Android 8+ is supported.

Validation: unit tests, release lint, and optimized APK build. Physical-device testing will be completed by the owner. The APK checksum is provided in **SHA256SUMS.txt**. This is a development-signed sideload build, not a Play Store release.

This is a custom Compose interface inspired by Samsung settings, not Samsung firmware or an official One UI/SESL distribution. Retailer integrations for eMAG, Vexio, and Altex remain experimental and require physical-device testing.
